title: GitHub - openai/php2shell-checker
html:
Check a website or local PHP binary to see if it's vulnerable to php2shell.

To install both skills, ask Codex:

      
$skill-installer install both skills from https://github.com/openai/php2shell-checker

Use phpcheck-server when you have server access, or phpcheck-url when you only have a URL:

      
$phpcheck-url check https://example.com


    
      
$phpcheck-server check the PHP version serving my site

Check a website:

node phpcheck.js "https://example.com"

Check the local CLI PHP

node phpcheck.js --local
Result Exit code Meaning 
OK
 
0
 Stable PHP patch version above the embedded cutoff for a listed major/minor branch.
VULNERABLE
 
1
 PHP version at or below the embedded cutoff for that branch.
UNKNOWN
 
3
 No PHP version or response, an unrecognized version/branch, or a newer prerelease build.

Use 

--json
for machine-readable output (
patch_status
is 
ok
, 
vulnerable
, or 
unknown
). Invalid arguments exit with code 
2
.

node --test phpcheck.test.js

Tests run the CLI against local HTTP servers and a fake PHP executable. No PHP installation or external website is required.

The checker only evaluates versions exposed in HTTP response headers or by 

php -v
. It reads 
X-Powered-By
and 
Server
, sends 
HEAD
, and falls back to 
GET
only when 
HEAD
returns 405 or 501. It does not follow redirects or inspect response bodies. Missing or hidden PHP headers return 
UNKNOWN
.

OK
is a version comparison based on the assumption that subsequent stable patches in each listed branch contain the fix. It does not independently verify a security fix. Check the versions against the official PHP security release. Headers can be hidden or changed, and distribution backports may not change the upstream version. 
UNKNOWN
does not mean the target is patched!

OpenAI is not accepting external code contributions to this project. Bug reports and non-code feedback are welcome through GitHub issues. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

This project is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
markdown:
Check a website or local PHP binary to see if it's vulnerable to php2shell.

To install both skills, ask Codex:

```
$skill-installer install both skills from https://github.com/openai/php2shell-checker
```
Use [phpcheck-server](/openai/php2shell-checker/blob/main/skills/phpcheck-server/SKILL.md) when you have server
access, or [phpcheck-url](/openai/php2shell-checker/blob/main/skills/phpcheck-url/SKILL.md) when you only have a URL:

```
$phpcheck-url check https://example.com
```
```
$phpcheck-server check the PHP version serving my site
```
Check a website:

`node phpcheck.js "https://example.com"`
Check the local CLI PHP

`node phpcheck.js --local`
| Result | Exit code | Meaning | 
|---|---|---|
| `OK` | `0` | Stable PHP patch version above the embedded cutoff for a listed major/minor branch. | 
| `VULNERABLE` | `1` | PHP version at or below the embedded cutoff for that branch. | 
| `UNKNOWN` | `3` | No PHP version or response, an unrecognized version/branch, or a newer prerelease build. | 

Use `--json` for machine-readable output (`patch_status` is `ok`, `vulnerable`,
or `unknown`). Invalid arguments exit with code `2`.

`node --test phpcheck.test.js`
Tests run the CLI against local HTTP servers and a fake PHP executable. No PHP installation or external website is required.

The checker only evaluates versions exposed in HTTP response headers or by
`php -v`. It reads `X-Powered-By` and `Server`, sends `HEAD`, and falls back to
`GET` only when `HEAD` returns 405 or 501. It does not follow redirects or
inspect response bodies. Missing or hidden PHP headers return `UNKNOWN`.

`OK` is a version comparison based on the assumption that subsequent stable patches in each listed branch contain the fix.
It does not independently verify a security fix. Check the versions against
the official PHP security release. Headers can be hidden or changed, and distribution backports may
not change the upstream version. `UNKNOWN` does not mean the target is patched!

OpenAI is not accepting external code contributions to this project. Bug
reports and non-code feedback are welcome through GitHub issues. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](/openai/php2shell-checker/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

This project is licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](/openai/php2shell-checker/blob/main/LICENSE).
html_zh:
检查网站或本地 PHP 二进制文件，看看它是否容易受到 php2shell 的攻击。

要安装这两种技能，请询问 Codex：

      
$skill-installer install both skills from https://github.com/openai/php2shell-checker

当您有服务器访问权限时使用phpcheck-server ，或者当您只有 URL 时使用phpcheck-url ：

      
$phpcheck-url check https://example.com


    
      
$phpcheck-server check the PHP version serving my site

检查一个网站：

node phpcheck.js "https://example.com"

检查本地 CLI PHP

node phpcheck.js --local
结果 退出代码 意义 
好的
 
0
 稳定的 PHP 补丁版本高于列出的主要/次要分支的嵌入截止值。
易受伤害的
 
1
 PHP 版本等于或低于该分支的嵌入截止值。
未知
 
3
 没有 PHP 版本或响应、无法识别的版本/分支或较新的预发布版本。

使用

--json
用于机器可读的输出（
patch_status
是
ok
, 
vulnerable
， 或者
unknown
）。无效参数退出并显示代码
2
.

node --test phpcheck.test.js

测试针对本地 HTTP 服务器和伪造的 PHP 可执行文件运行 CLI。无需安装 PHP 或外部网站。

检查器仅评估 HTTP 响应标头中公开的版本或通过

php -v
。上面写着
X-Powered-By
和
Server
, 发送
HEAD
，并回落到
GET
仅当
HEAD
返回 405 或 501。它不遵循重定向或检查响应主体。丢失或隐藏的 PHP 标头返回
UNKNOWN
.

OK
是基于每个列出的分支中的后续稳定补丁包含修复程序的假设的版本比较。它不独立验证安全修复。根据官方 PHP 安全版本检查版本。标头可以隐藏或更改，并且分发向后移植可能不会更改上游版本。
UNKNOWN
并不意味着目标已被修补！

OpenAI 不接受对该项目的外部代码贡献。欢迎通过 GitHub issues 进行错误报告和非代码反馈。请参阅CONTRIBUTING.md 。

该项目根据Apache License 2.0获得许可。
summary_zh: php2shell-checker 是 OpenAI 开源（Apache 2.0）的检查工具，用来判断网站或本机 PHP 是否受 php2shell 漏洞影响，可作为两个 Codex 技能安装：有服务器权限用 phpcheck-server，只有网址用 phpcheck-url。也可直接运行 node phpcheck.js 检查网址或本地 PHP，结果分 OK、VULNERABLE、UNKNOWN 三种，支持 --json 输出。它只读取 HTTP 响应头（X-Powered-By、Server）或 php -v 暴露的版本号，不验证修复本身；头信息被隐藏时返回 UNKNOWN，且 UNKNOWN 不代表已打补丁，应对照 PHP 官方安全公告确认。
